# Tohund Guide — Bank Statement to Excel Converter
> Free online tool to convert Indian bank statements (PDF, DOCX, TXT) into clean, formatted Excel spreadsheets.

## About
This is a free, no-signup tool by Tohund Guide that converts bank statements from PDF format into structured Excel files. It supports 10+ Indian banks including JK Bank, HDFC, ICICI, SBI, PNB, Kotak, and Equitas. It also has an AI-powered fallback parser that can handle any bank format automatically. The tool includes OCR support for scanned PDFs and can handle password-protected files.

## URL
https://tohundguide.com/tools/convertbankstatementtoexcel

## Features
- Converts bank statement PDFs to formatted Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files
- Auto-detects bank format — just upload and go
- Supports 10+ Indian banks: JK Bank, HDFC, ICICI, SBI, PNB, Kotak, Equitas, and more
- AI-powered fallback parser for unsupported bank formats
- OCR support for scanned/image-based PDFs via Tesseract
- Handles password-protected PDFs
- Balance verification column (auto-checks if transactions add up)
- Monthly summary sheet with charts
- Narration mapping sheet with VLOOKUP formulas for transaction categorization
- 100% free, no signup required, no data stored after processing
- Works on any device with a browser

## Use Cases
- Chartered Accountants converting client bank statements for audit/tax filing
- Small business owners analyzing their bank transactions in Excel
- Tax professionals preparing ITR (Income Tax Return) from bank statements
- Students and individuals tracking personal expenses from bank statements
- Auditors verifying transaction accuracy with auto-balance-check
- Accountants doing bank reconciliation

## Supported Banks
JK Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, State Bank of India (SBI), Punjab National Bank (PNB), Kotak Mahindra Bank, Equitas Small Finance Bank, and any other bank via AI parser

## Privacy
- Files are processed in memory and deleted immediately after conversion
- No personal data is stored
- No signup or login required
- Auto-cleanup removes any temporary files within 1 hour

## About Tohund Guide
Tohund Guide (tohundguide.com) provides free financial tools and guides for Indian professionals, businesses, and individuals.
